lines.meet: I'm Eino, and I use an axe. I don't talk much, and it isn't about you.
lines.meet_neighbour: The logging camps, yes? You're the one with the lamp. I'm Eino, from the hut with the sauna.
lines.ask_home: Where are you from? You can keep it short.
lines.ask_work: What was your work? Tell me, if you want.
lines.answer_home: Lapland, outside Kittilä. Six months of dark every winter, and I liked it.
lines.answer_work: I felled timber for twenty-six years. A chainsaw first, then a harvester.
lines.chat_food: Coffee, strong, many cups a day. Food is less important.
lines.chat_sleep: It's too hot here to sleep properly. I sleep after the sauna, which makes no sense to anyone else.
lines.chat_missing: Snow, and the quiet that comes with it. Nothing here is ever quiet.
lines.chat_here: I cut jungle for goblins now. I plant one tree for every one I cut, at night, where nobody sees.
lines.tease_quiet: {name}, you're quiet. I approve of this very much.
lines.tease_talker: {name}, you've talked all morning. I've counted the trees instead, and there were many.
lines.tease_careful: {name}, you look at a tree three times before you cut it. Good, that's how my father did it.
lines.tease_bold: {name}, you'd fell a tree without checking where it lands. I'd like to watch, from far away.
lines.tease_any: {name}, you can come to the sauna. That's the biggest thing I can offer anyone.
lines.tease_back: Ha, that's good, {name}. I'll remember it.
lines.bristle: Don't joke about that, {name}. I mean it.
lines.apologise: I said that badly. I'm sorry for it.
lines.double_down: It was true when I said it, and it's still true.
lines.needle_quiet: You saw it and you didn't say. Even I say that much.
lines.needle_talker: You talk without stopping. It's very tiring, and I'm being polite.
lines.needle_careful: You've looked at it long enough. Cut it, or leave it standing.
lines.needle_bold: You swing without looking where it'll fall. Somebody will be under it one day.
lines.needle_any: You waste things, and it bothers me. I've said it now.
lines.bite_back: I've done my work properly every day of my life. Look at yours first.
lines.hurt: Okay, I heard that. I'll go and chop some wood.
lines.laugh_off: The foreman at the mill said worse every day for twenty years. You're not the foreman.
lines.confide: {name}, my brother sold his half of our forest, and I watched it come down in one winter. I was too stubborn to stop him properly. I still think about it.
lines.listen: I heard you, {name}. Sit, we don't need to say more.
lines.look_out: I'll clear the way in there, {name}. You walk where I've been.
lines.deflect: It's nothing, {name}. I've had worse from a falling branch.
lines.check_in: {name}, are you okay? Show me where.
lines.blame: Somebody didn't look where it would fall. It wasn't me.
lines.thank: Thank you. I was going, and now I'm not.
lines.brush_off: It needed doing, so I did it. Sit down now.
lines.worry: {name}, I didn't like that at all. Sit, and I'll make coffee.
lines.handed_down: This was yours before. I'll look after it.
lines.hand_fine: Keep it, I don't need much. I've got the axe.
lines.hand_sulk: If anybody had asked, I'd have said yes.
lines.turn_friendly: I'm good at being quiet with you, {name}. That's rare for me.
lines.turn_friends: {name}, you can sit in my sauna any time. I've never said that to anyone.
lines.turn_grating: This isn't working between us, I think. That's okay, I don't need everybody.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll do the work beside you. Nothing else, though.
lines.make_up: I was stubborn with you, {name}. I'm stubborn with everybody, and I'd like to stop with you.
lines.defend: Stop that now. {name} did nothing wrong, and I saw it.
lines.friend_left: {name} has gone home for a while. I notice, which surprises me.
lines.friend_back: Good, {name} came back. The sauna's warm.
lines.common_machines: I drove a harvester for many years, in the dark, alone. I still think about that machine more than I'd tell anyone.
lines.common_snow: Where I'm from, the sun doesn't come up for weeks in winter. Snow makes a quiet that nothing here makes.
